title: Activation cadence and risk mitigation matrix for Acme Corp POC
body:
Objective:
- Run a 4-week activation for Acme Corp to validate Redwood inference for document summarization at 100 concurrent users and to confirm cost/latency targets for Dedicated capacity recommendation.

Context:
- Customer: Acme Corp (legal + security review nearly complete).
- Primary contact: Jenna Rios (Acme product).
- Goal: Deliver a reproducible configuration and runbook so Acme can decide between hosted vs dedicated.
- Constraints: data residency requirement in eu-west, initial dataset contains PII (PII token redaction must be verified).

Scope (what we will deliver):
- Baseline latency/cost runbook (sample traffic profile).
- Integration guide for S3 ingestion + Redwood streaming API.
- 4-week activation cadence with daily check-ins during week 1.
- Risk mitigation matrix and an escape plan for mid-activation failures.

Success metrics (measurable targets):
- p95 latency <= 420ms for 512-token requests (90% of time under load test).
- Unit cost <= $0.004 per 1k tokens for steady state with suggested batching.
- End-to-end correctness: F1 >= 0.88 vs our labeled subset for summaries.
- Security: no PII found in logs during smoke tests.

Acceptance criteria (customer signoff):
- Demo run in week 4 that reproduces baseline benchmarks.
- Runbook and config pushed to Acme repo with PR accepted.
- Security checklist signed by Acme security and Redwood SRE.

High-level timeline (week-by-week):
- Week -1 (Pre-activation): account provisioning, KMS handshake, sample dataset exchange, design review. Owner: Diego.
- Week 0 (Prep): infra templates, test harness, baseline synthetic tests. Owner: Samir.
- Week 1 (Integrator workshop + smoke): on-site/remote workshop, connect ingestion, basic models, verify PII redaction. Daily check-ins. Owner: Maya + Priya.
- Week 2 (Scale tests): ramp to 100 concurrent users, enable batching/caching, measure p95/p50. Owner: Platform Eng.
- Week 3 (Regression & Observability): run regression tests, integrate Redwood Console dashboards, alerting. Owner: Observability lead.
- Week 4 (Sign-off & Handover): final demo, runbook handoff, license/commit discussion. Owner: Solutions Eng lead.

Sprint-style task board (current snapshot):
- Backlog:
  - add S3 connector template for Acme (owner: Samir) — ETA: W0 — status: in backlog
  - create PII test cases (owner: Priya) — ETA: W0 — status: in backlog
- In progress:
  - workshop slide deck (owner: Maya) — ETA: W0+2 days — status: in progress — blocker: need final dataset sample from Jenna
  - provision eu-west staging (owner: Diego) — ETA: W0+1 day — status: in progress
- Blocked:
  - KMS cross-account policy (owner: Security Eng) — blocker detail: legal approval pending
- Done:
  - initial architecture sketch + cost estimate (owner: Maya) — done on 2024-11-04

Risk mitigation matrix (top 6 risks):
1) Data residency or KMS delays
   - Likelihood: medium
   - Impact: high
   - Mitigation: run a temporary eu-west sandbox using customer-provisioned keys; allow masked dataset if KMS delayed
   - Contingency: use hashed sample dataset for early latency tests. Escalation owner: Diego

2) PII leakage in logs
   - Likelihood: low
   - Impact: critical
   - Mitigation: enable log redaction, sample stream validation, automated PII detectors on ingestion path
   - Contingency: pause ingestion, rotate keys, re-run tests. Escalation owner: Priya

3) Model latency regression under real traffic
   - Likelihood: medium
   - Impact: medium
   - Mitigation: pre-configure lighter quantized variant and automatic fallback policy, configure autoscale thresholds
   - Contingency: move to dedicated reserved capacity for customer-critical endpoints. Escalation owner: Platform Eng

4) Missing network egress firewall rule in Acme VPC
   - Likelihood: medium
   - Impact: high (blocks integration)
   - Mitigation: include firewall checklist in pre-activation onboarding doc, pair with Acme network engineer before workshop
   - Contingency: establish temporary VPN tunnel. Escalation owner: Maya

5) Unauthorized cost spikes during load tests
   - Likelihood: low
   - Impact: medium
   - Mitigation: set hard budget guards and rate limits in staging; use token caps and throttles
   - Contingency: throttle at gateway, revert to baseline model. Escalation owner: Finance DSM contact

6) Key staff availability during critical window
   - Likelihood: medium
   - Impact: medium
   - Mitigation: assign backups and overlap hours for handover; create live runbook with step-by-step execs
   - Contingency: escalate to SE manager for resource re-allocation. Escalation owner: Maya

Escape plan / rollback triggers:
- Trigger: p95 latency > 1s for 10 consecutive minutes during a customer demo -> rollback to prior model variant and reduce concurrency to 50.
- Trigger: repeated 5%+ unexpected token usage in synthetic tests -> pause test, audit request traces, enable stricter batching.
- Communication: all triggers require immediate Slack @oncall ping and a 15-minute incident call.

Workshop agenda (Day 1, 4 hours remote):
- 00:00-00:20 Intro: goals, success metrics, liaison intros
- 00:20-01:00 Architecture walkthrough (Redwood + Acme infra)
- 01:00-02:15 Hands-on: connect ingestion pipeline, run first sample generation
- 02:15-02:30 BREAK
- 02:30-03:15 Observability and alerting setup
- 03:15-04:00 Acceptance tests, next steps, Q&A

Prerequisites for customer:
- IAM user with eu-west access + KMS access granted
- Example dataset (5k docs) anonymized or consented
- Network contact for firewall rules

Escalation path (internal):
- Level 1: On-call SE (Priya) -> Level 2: Platform Lead (Samir) -> Level 3: SRE manager (Diego) -> Exec (Maya)

Open questions / notes to self:
- Jenna to confirm whether Acme will accept masked dataset (email pending).
- Confirm whether Acme needs audit logs retained for >90 days (compliance ask).
- Quick experiment: try 4-bit quantized model for summary quality check (Maya assign PR).
- Add a short checklist to workshop slides: `what to test if latency spikes` (debug steps + where to find traces).

Immediate next steps (this week):
- Maya: finalize slides and send calendar invite for workshop (ETA: 2024-11-06).
- Diego: finish eu-west staging provisioning and share SSH creds (ETA: 2024-11-05).
- Priya: draft PII test cases and automated checks (ETA: 2024-11-08).
- Samir: prepare S3 connector skeleton and sample pipeline (ETA: 2024-11-07).

Comments on coordination:
- Keep all tickets under SE-1423 epic. Use the `#acme-activation` Slack thread for ephemeral coordination.
- Prefer short daily async updates in the Slack thread; escalate blockers to the Friday sync if unresolved.
